[Verse 1]
[C#5]Hold it now! Wait a minute. Come on!
Just let me catch my breath.
I've heard the promises, I've seen the mistakes.
I've had my fair share of tough breaks. Need a
new voice, new law, new way. Take the time,
reevaluate. It's time to
pick up the pieces, go back to square one.
I think it's time for a change.

[Bridge]
[C#5]

[Verse 2]
[C#m7]There is something that I
[F#7add11]feel. To be something that is
[E]real. I feel the heat within my mind.
[F#]And craft new changes with my
[C#m7]eyes. Giving freely wandering
[F#7add11]promises. A place where decisions I'll
[E]fashion. I won't waste another breath.
[C#5]

[F#5]on.

[A5]weight of the world. But

[A5]time.

[E5]find all you need in your
[F#5]mind.
[B5]

[Verse 3]
[B5]Unbroken spirit, ob-
[E5]scured and disquiet, finds
[F#]clearness this trial de-

[B5]end of this day sights an
[C#5]anxious relief for the
[A5]fortunate lies still in his
[E5]head.
[B5]If there's a
[E5]pensive fear, a
[F#5]wasted year. A man
[A5]must learn to cope.
[B5]If his obses-
[C#5]sion's real, suppres-
[A5]sion that he feels
[E5]must turn to hope.

[E5]no more assuring than
[F#5]love.
[B5]

[E5]answers from voices a-

[B5]

[A5]time.

[F#5]mind.

around me.
